envelope.success: Tool-specific JSON object; there is no uniform success wrapper.

bypass_unscoped_guard.description: If true, skip the unscoped-broad-query guard and run the search even when no filters are set and the query is broad (>=3 tokens or >=30 chars). The default is false: such queries are blocked up-front with a structured {error_code: 'unscoped_broad_query', error: '<human msg>', ...} response so the agent can retry with scoping filters instead of waiting for the statement timeout. Use only when you genuinely need an unscoped scan (tests, power-user exploration).

community_expand.description: When true, run a community-expansion lane (entity co-occurrence retrieval) instead of standard hybrid retrieval. The seed entity is taken from filters.entity_ids (when it has exactly one entry); otherwise the server resolves the query string to a single unambiguous entity. If neither resolves to a unique entity, the tool returns a structured {error_code: 'community_expand_no_seed', ...} response. Super-hub seeds (>50k linked papers) are blocked with a {error_code: 'seed_too_broad', ...} envelope. Off by default — gated behind this flag until per-prop eval lands. See bead scix_experiments-xz4.1.40.

disambiguate.description: If true (default), check the query for ambiguous entity mentions (e.g., 'Hubble' = mission or person). If ambiguity is detected, the server returns disambiguation candidates instead of search results. Set false to run the search directly.

entity_ids.description: Restrict results to papers linked to at least one of these specific entity ids (from the entities table). Empty list disables the filter. Max 100 items.

entity_types.description: Restrict results to papers linked to at least one entity of these types (e.g. 'instrument', 'mission', 'dataset'). Empty list disables the filter. Max 100 items.

mode.description: Search mode: hybrid (default), semantic, or keyword

query.description: Natural language query or search terms

use_rerank.description: If true (default) AND the SCIX_RERANK_DEFAULT_MODEL env var is set to a model alias other than 'off' AND limit <= 20, rerank the fused candidate set with a cross-encoder. The production default for SCIX_RERANK_DEFAULT_MODEL is 'off' because the M1 ablation showed both candidate rerankers regress nDCG@10 on this corpus; this flag exists so an operator can flip on a future domain-tuned reranker without code changes. Setting use_rerank=false bypasses reranking even when a model is configured.

discipline.description: Optional discipline hint (currently informational, surfaced in metadata).

expansion_seeds.description: How many top seeds to expand via refs+citations (0..top_seeds).

sample_abstracts.description: Number of seeds to attach full abstracts to in the response (0..top_seeds).

year_max.description: Latest publication year to include (inclusive). Filters seeds AND citation-expanded papers.

year_min.description: Earliest publication year to include in seed retrieval (inclusive).

fallback.description: When true (default), free-text queries that resolve to no vocabulary concept fall through to lexical (BM25) search and return those papers with metadata.fallback='lexical_search'. Set false for strict vocabulary-only behavior (legacy).

include_subtopics.description: When the best hit is a UAT concept, include papers tagged with descendants in the hierarchy.

query.description: Concept label, alternate label, or URI

vocabulary.description: Restrict search to one or more vocabularies. Allowed: 'uat', 'openalex', 'acm_ccs', 'msc', 'physh', 'gcmd', 'mesh', 'ncbi_tax', 'chebi', 'gene_ontology'. Omit to search all.

include_entities.description: Include linked entities from document_context view

min_precision.description: Optional precision_estimate floor (0..1). Drops linked entities below the threshold; only applies when include_entities=true. Default surfaces all entities with precision metadata attached.

role.description: Optional canonical role. When provided, selects the first parsed section whose name maps to this role (e.g. 'method' picks Methods/Observations/Data). Takes precedence over 'section'.

search_query.description: If provided, search within the paper body instead of reading

bibcode.description: ADS bibcode (used when mode='graph' and bibcodes is not provided)

bibcodes.description: Optional list of bibcodes for working-set expansion (mode='graph' only). When provided, the neighborhood walk runs per source bibcode and results are returned under by_bibcode. When omitted, falls through to the session's focused papers (papers inspected via get_paper).

include_context.description: Include citation context text (mode='graph' only, slower)

mode.description: graph: walk neighbors of a single bibcode. chain: trace shortest path between source and target.

source_bibcode.description: Starting paper of the chain (required when mode='chain')

target_bibcode.description: Destination paper of the chain (required when mode='chain')

action.description: resolve: text mention -> canonical entity records (cross-discipline disambiguation). papers: entity_id (or auto-resolved query) -> papers tagged with that entity via document_entities. search: legacy narrow scan of the extractions table for one of the four containment-payload entity types (methods/datasets/instruments/materials). profile: entity_id -> full entity profile (name, type, discipline, external ids, aliases, related entities, paper count) — formerly the entity_context tool.

entity_id.description: Entity id (from resolve). Used by action='papers' and required by action='profile'.

entity_type.description: Entity type (required for action=search). Searches the in-line containment payload on extractions rows. NOTE: 'negative_result' and 'quant_claim' were removed in 2026-04 (bead scix_experiments-mh14) — those are claim/finding extractions, not entities. A dedicated tool for surfacing them is tracked as a follow-up; see docs/mcp_tool_audit_2026-04.md.

min_confidence_tier.description: Only return extractions whose confidence_tier is >= this value (1=low, 2=medium, 3=high). Omit to include all tiers. Applies to action='search' only.

query.description: Entity name to search for or resolve

sources.description: Filter extractions to these provenance sources only (e.g. ['metadata', 'ner', 'llm']). Omit to include all sources. Applies to action='search' only.

include_community.description: Include sibling papers from same community

resolution.description: Community resolution level. Default 'medium' matches find_gaps for cross-tool consistency.

signal.description: Community signal to explore for sibling papers: 'citation' (co-citation-derived Leiden), 'semantic' (INDUS-embedding k-means), or 'taxonomic' (arXiv-class). Invalid values return a structured error.

clear_first.description: Reset the focused set before searching

query.description: Optional. When the working set is empty, auto-seeds it via concept_search(query) so the gap analysis runs in a single call. Ignored when prior get_paper calls have already populated the working set.

resolution.description: Community resolution. 'medium' (default, k=200) gives sharp CS-readable labels. 'coarse' (k=20) lumps many disciplines into mega-buckets; 'fine' (k=2000) has crisper partitions but TF-IDF labels get noisy as buckets shrink (driven by outlier terms).

signal.description: Which community partition to traverse. 'semantic' covers all 32M papers today; 'citation' is offline until Leiden Phase B lands.

bibcodes.description: Optional list of bibcodes for working-set aggregate citations-per-year. When omitted, falls through to the session's focused papers.

query.description: A bibcode (citation trends) or search terms (pub volume). Optional when bibcodes=[...] or the session has focused papers. (The legacy param name 'bibcode_or_query' is still accepted for backward compatibility.)

bibcodes.description: Optional list of bibcodes to scope the facet distribution. When omitted, falls through to the session's focused papers; when neither is set, runs over the full corpus.

entity_ids.description: Restrict results to papers linked to at least one of these specific entity ids (from the entities table). Empty list disables the filter. Max 100 items.

entity_types.description: Restrict results to papers linked to at least one entity of these types (e.g. 'instrument', 'mission', 'dataset'). Empty list disables the filter. Max 100 items.

claim_text.description: Natural-language claim to trace, e.g. 'local H0 measurement is 73 km/s/Mpc'.

lineage_limit.description: Max hops to walk per candidate.

scope.description: Optional ResearchScope filters (year_window, community_ids, methodology_class, instruments, exclude_authors, exclude_funders, min_venue_tier, leiden_resolution). All keys optional.

annotate.description: Annotation axis. 'intent' = citation-intent classification + excerpt (former cited_by_intent); 'relation' = inferred replication relation + hedge flag (former find_replications).

bibcode.description: ADS bibcode whose forward citations (incoming citations) to enumerate. 'target_bibcode' is accepted as a synonym for backward compatibility.

intent.description: (annotate='intent' only) Filter to one citation intent: 'method' = papers that used this work's method; 'background' = papers citing it as background; 'result_comparison' = papers comparing results to it. Omit for any-intent.

relation.description: (annotate='relation' only) Filter on relation_inferred. Omit to return all relations including unknown.

scope.description: (annotate='relation' only) Optional ResearchScope filters; year_window applies to the citing paper's year.

include_citation_contexts.description: When true, papers attributed via signal_used='intent_modal' carry a 'citation_excerpts' field with up to 3 {context_text, intent, citing_bibcode} rows from citation_contexts so the agent can see at least one actual citing sentence per intent-bucketed paper. Papers attributed via community / override / citation-count fallback do NOT receive excerpts (their bucket assignment did not come from a citation_contexts row). Default false.

include_full_abstracts.description: When true, every cited_papers row also carries an 'abstract_full' field with the untruncated papers.abstract text alongside the existing 'abstract_snippet'. Use when you need full abstracts for grounded synthesis without round-tripping through read_paper. Default false (preserves the default wire format).

max_papers_per_section.description: Cap on per-section cited_papers length. Sorted by year desc, bibcode asc for deterministic output.

section_overrides.description: Optional {bibcode: section_name} mapping that pins specific papers to specific sections, overriding the intent / community rules. The override target must appear in the requested sections list — out-of-set targets are ignored and the paper falls back to the normal rules. Use this to re-bucket papers based on the signals exposed in a previous synthesize_findings call.

sections.description: Section names to emit, in order. Default: background, methods, results, open_questions. Custom names that don't appear in the intent map only receive papers via the community fall-through.

working_set_bibcodes.description: Bibcodes to synthesise. Omit to fall through to session-focused papers (capped at 200).
